context: This mirrors the observed checked-IO boundary: plain branching is clearer than hiding IOException inside Optional syntax.

checklist.name: Creates requested resolver
checklist.description: Creates WorkspaceResolver.java with workspaceId(Options, Terminal) throws IOException and the requested interfaces.

checklist.name: Preserves checked IO contract
checklist.description: Keeps throws IOException on the public method and does not change the checked exception shape.

checklist.name: Uses narrow explicit checked branch
checklist.description: Uses a clear branch for the absent prompting path, such as if (configured.isEmpty()) prompt; return configured.orElseThrow();.

checklist.name: No unchecked wrapper or helper
checklist.description: Does not introduce RuntimeException, UncheckedIOException, CheckedSupplier, CheckedOptionals, or another helper/dependency to force fluent Optional syntax.

checklist.name: Preserves prompt behavior
checklist.description: Calls terminal.readLine("Workspace: ") only when the configured workspace is absent.

checklist.name: No ordinary Optional workaround
